items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I marvel at people like Marl and also our beloved Mayor.

ctx.x: And this was at what hotel? The Beverly Wilshire?

The Beverly Wilshire. The funny thing, President Reagan was staying in the same hotel, but the Democrats had rented the main ballroom that night, and the Republicans were a little late for that one. So we played there. You know, they're really pushing our Mayor for Governor.
